_doc: Revert-verify mutants for c3f586b4 (#4291) — `create.ts`, the wiring that makes one `create` read each vault file once. M1 takes the default back to the non-memoising adapter (the state this ticket found); M2 withholds the shared reader from both collaborators at once; M3/M4 withhold it from one each, so a regression can be attributed rather than merely detected; M6 hands it out even when the adapter does not memoise, which is what S5 exists to forbid.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/create.ts

M1_default_adapter_does_not_memoise._note: The pre-fix state verbatim. It reddens more than S1 because the shared reader is derived FROM the adapter: with a plain NodeFsAdapter there is nothing to share, so both collaborators fall back to their own walks.

M2_shared_reader_never_offered._note: Type-preserving: the getter's return type already admits undefined. S1/S2 stay green — the adapter is still the memoising one, only the collaborators stop sharing it.

M3_shape_loader_reads_on_its_own._note_anchor: Multi-line on purpose: the one-line form `      readFile: this.sharedReader,` is a SUBSTRING of the validator's more-indented line, so a single-line anchor matches twice and the driver refuses it.
M3_shape_loader_reads_on_its_own._note: S6 stays green by construction, and that is the honest reading: a ShapeLoader reading through `fs/promises` bypasses the adapter entirely, so its reads never reach the spy S6 counts. S6 measures the shared path; S3 is what holds this collaborator on it.

M4_property_validator_reads_on_its_own._note: Same asymmetry as M3 — S6 cannot see reads that leave the adapter.

M7_injected_adapter_ignored._note_expect: MEASURED, not predicted: the first prediction was [S2], derived from the mutant's topic (integration-test-revert-verify §A44). S5 reddens too, and correctly — S5 injects a plain NodeFsAdapter, so ignoring the injection builds the memoising one there as well and the shared reader stops being undefined.
M7_injected_adapter_ignored._note: Added after the first driver run showed S2 reddening under NO mutant — an axis nothing can break is not an axis (integration-test-revert-verify §A8). `create-batch` depends on this branch: it passes its own PlanningFsAdapter carrying the batch's pending uids, and silently building a fresh one would drop them.

M6_reader_offered_for_a_non_memoising_ad._note: The cold path is the guarantee: with a plain NodeFsAdapter the collaborators must keep their own `fs/promises` walks, i.e. today's behaviour. Handing them a reader there would also be wrong on its own terms — the base readFile takes a vault-RELATIVE path and the walkers address absolutely.
